g.text: Six decision models + Ling Flash, a conventional LLM from my earlier test
Decision models: 50 singles/model; 10 requests per larger size. Failed attempts and retry backoff included.
Earlier Ling run: 50 singles; 100/40/20/10 requests at 10/25/50/100 questions. Incomplete responses included; no retries.
Clef ends at 50 questions. All decision-model points are native single requests.
Same ten evidence packets; different run dates. Question counts evenly spaced. Right panel uses a different vertical scale.
